parse.title: Priest (New Moon)
parse.text:
Overview

Priest (New Moon) is a MythicalMythical. He is only obtainable by evolving Priest with a Green Baby.

Evolving

Priest (New Moon) can evolve into Priest (Heaven) with the following materials:

Required Items: x1 Priest (New Moon)
x1 Heavenly Clock
Result
Priest
(Heaven)

Before evolving this unit, the unit must have 10000 Takedowns. [1]

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.
